verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a workflow for manual evidence artifacts with owners, due dates, renewal reminders or expiry tracking. What it does show is adjacent: generic in-platform task assignment with deadlines, owner and due-date tracking limited to AI Systems governance findings, and AI gap analysis that flags outdated timestamps on submitted evidence. None of these is per-artifact renewal or expiry management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact
